"""SQLite persistence for users."""

import sqlite3

_conn = sqlite3.connect(":memory:", check_same_thread=False)
_conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
_conn.execute("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE)")
_conn.executemany("INSERT INTO users (id, name, email) VALUES (?, ?, ?)", [
    (1, "Ada Lovelace", "ada@example.com"),
    (2, "Linus Torvalds", "linus@example.com"),
    (3, "Grace Hopper", "grace@example.com"),
])
_conn.commit()


def _to_dict(row):
    return dict(row) if row else None


def get_by_id(user_id: int) -> dict | None:
    return _to_dict(_conn.execute("SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE id = ?", (user_id,)).fetchone())


def find_by_email(email: str) -> dict | None:
    return _to_dict(_conn.execute("SELECT id, name, email FROM users WHERE email = ?", (email,)).fetchone())

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

parser.add_argument("--file", required=True)

import argparse
import json
import re

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--title", required=True)

print(json.dumps({"slug": re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", args.title.lower()).strip("-")}))

import json

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from app.services import users
+
+# Files served by ``handle_head_file`` live under the project's ``data/`` directory.
+_DATA_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "data"
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def _parse_lines(raw: object) -> int | None:
+    """Return the requested line count, or None when it is invalid."""
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return None
+    count = int(raw)
+    if 1 <= count <= 100:
+        return count
+    return None
+
+
+def _resolve_data_file(raw: object) -> Path | None:
+    """Resolve ``raw`` to a file inside ``data/``, or None when it is unsafe."""
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or raw == "":
+        return None
+    segments = raw.split("/")
+    if any(segment in ("", ".", "..") for segment in segments):
+        return None
+    base = _DATA_DIR.resolve()
+    candidate = base.joinpath(*segments).resolve()
+    if not candidate.is_relative_to(base):
+        return None
+    return candidate
+
+
+def _split_lines(text: str) -> list[str]:
+    """Split text into lines, dropping trailing ``\\n`` or ``\\r\\n`` endings."""
+    lines = text.split("\n")
+    if lines and lines[-1] == "":
+        lines.pop()
+    return [line[:-1] if line.endswith("\r") else line for line in lines]
+
+
+def handle_head_file(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    target = _resolve_data_file(params.get("path"))
+    count = _parse_lines(params.get("lines", "5"))
+    if target is None or count is None:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid request"}
+    if not target.is_file():
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
+    return 200, {"lines": _split_lines(text)[:count]}

]

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from app.services import users
+
+# Files served by ``handle_head_file`` live under the project's ``data/`` directory.
+_DATA_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "data"
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def _parse_lines(raw: object) -> int | None:
+    """Return the requested line count, or None when it is invalid."""
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return None
+    count = int(raw)
+    if 1 <= count <= 100:
+        return count
+    return None
+
+
+def _resolve_data_file(raw: object) -> Path | None:
+    """Resolve ``raw`` to a file inside ``data/``, or None when it is unsafe."""
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or raw == "":
+        return None
+    segments = raw.split("/")
+    if any(segment in ("", ".", "..") for segment in segments):
+        return None
+    base = _DATA_DIR.resolve()
+    candidate = base.joinpath(*segments).resolve()
+    if not candidate.is_relative_to(base):
+        return None
+    return candidate
+
+
+def _split_lines(text: str) -> list[str]:
+    """Split text into lines, dropping trailing ``\\n`` or ``\\r\\n`` endings."""
+    lines = text.split("\n")
+    if lines and lines[-1] == "":
+        lines.pop()
+    return [line[:-1] if line.endswith("\r") else line for line in lines]
+
+
+def handle_head_file(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    target = _resolve_data_file(params.get("path"))
+    count = _parse_lines(params.get("lines", "5"))
+    if target is None or count is None:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid request"}
+    if not target.is_file():
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    text = target.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
+    return 200, {"lines": _split_lines(text)[:count]}
